title: Senior Systems Engineer
description:
**About Us (Ensono)**



Ensono is an expert technology adviser and managed service provider. As a relentless ally, we accelerate clients' digital transformation to achieve business outcomes that stand to last. Our dedicated team helps organizations optimize today's systems across any hybrid environment with services such as consulting, mainframe and application modernization, public cloud migration and cloud\-native development. With certified experts in AWS, Azure and Google Cloud and recognized as Microsoft Datacenter Transformation Partner of the Year, Ensono has over 3500\+ associates globally and is headquartered in greater Chicago. We care about your success, offering comprehensive strategic and managed services for mission\-critical applications. Our Advisory and Consulting services can help upfront with an application strategy or find the right places for your applications – whether it's public, multi or hybrid cloud, or mainframe. And because we span across all mission\-critical platforms, we can meet you wherever you are in your digital transformation journey, with 24/7 support when you need it. We are your relentless ally, flexing with you when challenges emerge so you don't feel stuck in place. With cross\-platform certifications and decades of experience, our technology experts have become an extension of your team so you're continuously innovating – doing more with less while remaining secure. And that's just the beginning.


**Job Description – Linux L3 System Administrator**


**Job Summary**



The Linux L3 System Administrator is responsible for advanced administration, architecture, automation, and support of enterprise Linux environments across on\-premises and cloud platforms. The role focuses on infrastructure automation using Terraform, container platform administration, cloud provisioning, performance optimization, and providing technical leadership for complex incidents and infrastructure transformation initiatives.



Key Responsibilities


* Provide L3\-level support for Linux operating systems including RHEL, Oracle Linux, Rocky Linux, and CentOS.
* Act as the final escalation point for complex operating system, performance, and infrastructure issues.
* Design, deploy, and maintain highly available Linux platforms in physical, virtual, and cloud environments.
* Develop and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform.
* Create, maintain, and optimize Terraform modules, workspaces, and state management processes.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning across Azure, AWS, OCI, or hybrid cloud environments.
* Administer and support Kubernetes/OpenShift container platforms.
* Deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and upgrade Kubernetes clusters and worker nodes.
* Implement automation using Ansible, Terraform, Shell scripting, and Python.
* Manage Linux storage technologies including LVM, Multipathing, SAN/NAS integrations, and enterprise storage solutions.
* Lead OS patching, upgrades, lifecycle management, and vulnerability remediation activities.
* Drive security hardening and compliance initiatives across Linux and cloud environments.
* Analyze system performance and perform proactive capacity planning and tuning.
* Support VMware and enterprise virtualization platforms.
* Collaborate with application, database, network, cloud, and security teams on solution design and implementation.
* Participate in major incident management, root cause analysis, and problem management activities.
* Mentor L1/L2 engineers and contribute to documentation, SOPs, and best practices.
* Participate in 24x7 on\-call support and planned maintenance activities.


Required Skills \& Experience


* 8–10\+ years of enterprise Linux administration experience.
* Strong expertise in:
* + Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)
	+ Oracle Linux
	+ Rocky Linux
* Hands\-on experience with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management.
* Experience creating reusable Terraform modules and managing remote state backends.
* Strong knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and DevOps practices.
* Experience with Kubernetes and/or OpenShift administration.
* Proficiency with Ansible automation.
* Strong Shell scripting (Bash) and Python skills.
* Experience with:
* + LVM
	+ Multipathing (DM\-Multipath/PowerPath)
	+ SAN/NAS Storage
	+ Enterprise Backup Solutions
* Advanced Linux troubleshooting and performance tuning experience.
* Strong understanding of networking concepts:
* + DNS
	+ TCP/IP
	+ VLANs
	+ Bonding
	+ Load Balancing
* Experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM tools.
* Experience working in mission\-critical 24x7 production environments.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* RHCE / RHCA certification.
* HashiCorp Terraform Associate certification.
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA).
* Red Hat OpenShift Certification.
* Azure Administrator, AWS SysOps, or OCI certifications.
* Experience with GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps pipelines.
* Exposure to GitOps tools such as ArgoCD or FluxCD.
* Experience supporting cloud\-native and microservices\-based environments.
* ITIL Foundation certification.


Professional Attributes


* Strong ownership mindset and decision‑making capabilities
* Ability to handle high‑pressure, business‑critical incidents
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Passion for automation, standardization, and continuous improvement


We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to caste, colour, creed, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, HIV status, or any other status protected by law. Candidates with disabilities who require accommodations during the recruitment process are encouraged to contact our Talent Acquisition team to place a request.

title: Senior Citrix Systems Engineer
description:
**ABOUT US**


Ensono is a hybrid IT services provider that sees a world in transformation. We understand the world of business has become more complex, layered, and interdependent because we’re enabling the IT infrastructure for that transformation. Our clients are some of the most innovative and forward\-thinking companies in the world and we help keep their businesses thriving. With nearly 50 years of experience, we optimize and modernize IT infrastructure by amplifying the power of mainframes and mid\-range servers with the agility of cloud. Check us out at www.ensono.com

  



**VDI Architecture \& Design**


* Implement and Support **enterprise\-scale Citrix and VMware Horizon environments**.
* Architect secure and scalable **VDI platforms** supporting thousands of global users.
* Evaluate infrastructure requirements including **compute, storage, network, and security**.
* Develop high availability, disaster recovery, and failover strategies.

**Citrix Administration**


* Manage **Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD)** and **Citrix Cloud** environments.
* Configure and maintain:
* Delivery Controllers
* Citrix StoreFront
* Citrix Gateway / NetScaler
* Citrix Director \& Studio
* Citrix FAS
* Manage **Machine Creation Services (MCS) and Provisioning Services (PVS)**.


* Perform **performance tuning and troubleshooting**.


**VMware Horizon Administration**


* Manage **VMware Horizon environments** including:
* Horizon Connection Servers
* Unified Access Gateway (UAG)
* Instant Clone \& Linked Clone environments
* App Volumes and Dynamic Environment Manager
* Monitor and optimize VDI performance and capacity.


**End User Computing (EUC) Operations**


* Ensure optimal **user experience for remote and on\-prem users**.
* Manage **gold images, application delivery, and patching cycles**.
* Support **Windows 10 / Windows 11 VDI environments**.
* Work closely with **Service Desk and Infrastructure teams**.

**Security \& Compliance**


* Implement security best practices including:
* Multi\-Factor Authentication
* Secure remote access
* Endpoint security integration
* Ensure compliance with **enterprise security standards**.


**Monitoring \& Troubleshooting**


* Monitor VDI environments using tools such as:
* Citrix Director
* ControlUp
* VMware vRealize Operations
* Perform **root cause analysis for performance and connectivity issues**.


**Automation \& Optimization**


* Automate deployment and maintenance using **PowerShell, scripting, or orchestration tools**.
* Continuously improve VDI efficiency and reduce operational overhead.

**Required Skills \& Experience**


**Experience**


* **5\+ years working with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops**
* **5\+ years working with VMware Horizon**

**Technical Skills**


Strong hands\-on experience with:


**Citrix Technologies**


* Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops
* Citrix Cloud
* Citrix Gateway / NetScaler
* Citrix FAS
* Citrix StoreFront
* Citrix Director \& Studio
* Citrix MCS / PVS

**VMware Technologies**


* VMware Horizon
* App Volumes
* Dynamic Environment Manager
* Instant Clones
* VMware vSphere

**Other Skills**


* Windows Server Administration
* Window 11 Administration
* Active Directory \& Group Policy
* Networking (DNS, DHCP, Load Balancers)
* Storage technologies
* Azure / AWS VDI (optional but preferred)
* PowerShell scripting

**Preferred Certifications**


* **Citrix Certified Professional (CCP\-V)**
* **Citrix Certified Expert (CCE\-V)**
* **VMware Certified Professional – Desktop and Mobility (VCP\-DTM)**
* Microsoft Azure certifications (preferred)

**Soft Skills**


* Strong problem\-solving skills
* Ability to work in **global enterprise environments**
* Excellent stakeholder communication
* Leadership and mentoring capability

**Nice to Have**


* Experience managing **10,000\+ VDI users**
* Experience with **DaaS (Citrix Cloud / Horizon Cloud)**
* Knowledge of **Zero Trust access models**
* Experience with **Workspace One or Intune**

title: Lead IT System Admin
description:
**Job Posting Title**


Lead IT System Admin**Job Description Summary**


Responsible for overseeing the daily operations and administration of the IT server infrastructure. Performs a wide variety of technical duties which include, but are not limited to analysis, installation, configuration, modification, documentation, maintenance, problem diagnosis, and repair of all server technology hardware and software. Provides hardware and software technical guidance to core IT administrators and remote sites.**Job Description:**


Act as local IT support, co\-operate with corporate IT to implement standard applications and infrastructure systems in time and with high quality


Maintain IT local applications and infrastructure according to corporate IT strategy, standards, policies and best practices


Work closely with local cross function team supporting Regional/Corporate IT team on site ERP/Other major systems implementation, optimization project support/assistant


Work closely with the Plant operation and ME team to support Regional/Corporate IT on MES system implementation, optimization and supporting


IT support for local users, utilize FreshService System on incidents, problem, and change management


Work closely with Regional/Corp IT team on IT applications or systems update/optimization, be the bridge of local team and corporate IT team on new project launching


Assist finance manager on IT related budget and forecast.


Ensure IT orientation for new associates, regular IT training for end users.


All other duties as assigned

  



**Required Skills and Education**

* Bachelor’s degree major in computer science or relevant majors
* Above 8 years’ experience in Infrastructure support
* Above 2 years’ experience in ERP and MES application support
* In\-deep experience on troubleshooting and end user helpdesk supporting
* Good documentation experience (Visio, Word, etc.)
* People management skill

 **About Dauch:**


Dauch Corporation is a premier Driveline and Metal Forming supplier serving the global automotive industry with a powertrain\-agnostic product portfolio that supports electric, hybrid, and internal combustion vehicles. The company is headquartered in Detroit, MI, with operations that span 24 countries and more than 175 locations. Formed through the acquisition of Dowlais Group plc and its subsidiaries \- GKN Automotive and GKN Powder Metallurgy, Dauch unites deep engineering roots with global manufacturing capabilities and an entrepreneurial spirit to move mobility forward. Visit www.dauch.com to learn more.
